caption: The drawing depicts three views of a flat ballet-style shoe on a beige background. In the lower half of the composition, a side view of the shoe is shown in detail, colored in light brown with shading to indicate volume and form. The shoe has simple stitching along the top edge, a bow at the front, and a pair of loose, trailing shoelaces. Above this, two outline sketches of the shoe are presented in thin black or gray lines. The left outline shows a top view of the shoe, including an illustration of the bow and the interior seam lines, while the right outline shows the sole or bottom view of the shoe, marked only by the central seam. The entire drawing uses subtle, light colors and fine line work.
title: Slipper
